verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical, so neither is the better resize. Both share the same flaws: the portrait photo is cut down to a thin strip, so it loses its impact. The white highlight bar and the gold underline are left floating on the photo, detached from the headline they used to sit behind. The large circle is cropped awkwardly at the top edge. The dots and the gold rules are scattered around the edges with no clear grid, so the layout reads as a shrunk collage rather than a deliberate rearrangement.
